summary: The Template module manages template records for various purposes including emails and general content. It provides CRUD operations and search functionalities. Templates consist of multilingual fields and are stored in the database.
purpose: To store, retrieve, update, and delete template records containing textual content and alternate language fields. Also used for email template management and searching templates by name or ID.

workflows.name: Add Template
steps: Validate input fields: Name, Template, TemplateAlt

workflows.name: Update Template
steps: Check if ID is not zero
Add parameters: ID, Name, Template, TemplateAlt

workflows.name: Delete Template
steps: Check if ID is not zero

business_rules: Name must be specified for a template
Template and TemplateAlt must be specified
Update and Delete operations require a valid ID
validations: Blank Template or TemplateAlt not allowed
conditions: ID != 0 required for update and delete
Use alternate language fields if sess.UseAltLanguageFields is true
system_behavior: Templates are managed via database stored procedures
dependencies: Database stored procedures: TemplateAdd, TemplateUpdate, TemplateDelete, TemplateList, TemplateLookup, EmailTemplateLookup, TemplateSearchID
exceptions: Validation failures (Name, Template, TemplateAlt) return errors and stop processing
content_gaps: No explicit error handling or logging mechanisms beyond basic validation
No description of template content structure or usage context
